subject: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@novahealth.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & numbers from today's discovery call

Hi Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together the renewal/expansion pricing options you can review with finance: 

1) Current baseline
- Production traffic today: ~10M tokens/month on the primary chat route (gpt-like model)
- Embedding usage (search index updates): ~2M tokens/month

2) 12-month forecast you mentioned
- Steady growth to ~50M tokens/month by end of term (mix: ~70% chat, 30% embeddings/new routes)

3) Budget target / unit economics
- You mentioned a target blended budget in the range of $12k–$18k/month for the next phase, which maps to ~ $240–$360 per 1M tokens depending on model mix and routes. Confirming that's the right ballpark?

4) Asks / next steps
- Please confirm the committed volume tier(s) you’d consider for a renewal term (examples downstream in my note).
- Any additional routes/models you plan to add (e.g., cheap reranker, private reranker, or a smaller instruction model) and estimated tokens/month for each.

I'll prepare 2 pricing structures: (A) conservative step-up (lower initial commit, steeper step-ups) and (B) blended-rate commit (higher commit, flatter blended $/1M). I’ll include assumptions for model mix and fallback routing.

Attaching a short worksheet to make edits — if you can drop the committed tiers you’re comfortable with, I’ll turn it into a formal amendment and show the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: novahealth-pricing-proposal-v2.xlsx
From: Tom Reyes <tom@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & numbers from today's discovery call

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Confirming the numbers from our side: 
- Current production: 10M tokens/mo chat, 2M embeddings as you listed.
- Forecast: 50M tokens/mo within 9–12 months is reasonable; biggest uncertainty is adoption of the new summarization route (we expect ~6–8M tokens/mo by Q3).
- Budget: finance is aiming for a target of ~$300/1M tokens blended for the first year, but open to tiered step-ups if the math works.

We plan to add two routes in the renewal window:
- Summarization route (smaller LLM, estimated 6–8M tokens/mo)
- Private reranker for HIPAA-sensitive queries (embeddings-heavy, 1.5–2M tokens/mo)

Can you include a blended-rate option that shows the blended $/1M across the expected model mix (chat + summarization + embeddings)? Also please show a step-up schedule (0–12 months) with 2–3 tiers and what the committed rates would be vs. on-demand.

If you can get something over by EOD Wednesday PST, I can run it by finance and we’ll aim to lock the term next week.

—Tom
Director of Product
Nova Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@novahealth.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:38:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing options for renewal: step-ups and blended rates (proposal attached)

Tom — thanks for the confirmation. Attached is proposal v2 and a short worksheet that shows assumptions. Highlights below (all $ are USD):

Option A — Step-up tiers (12-month term)- Commit 15M T/month initial, step to 35M at month 6, 50M by month 12
- Rates (chat-heavy model mix): 
  - Months 1–5: $420 / 1M tokens (committed rate)
  - Months 6–11: $360 / 1M tokens (committed rate)
  - Month 12+: $320 / 1M tokens (committed rate)
- On-demand fallback: $620 / 1M tokens

Option B — Blended commit (12-month term)- Commit 50M average monthly over term (single blended rate)
- Blended rate (assumes 70% chat / 20% summarization / 10% embeddings): $295 / 1M tokens blended
- Includes discount for routing consolidation and prefix caching assumptions.

Notes on new routes/models
- Summarization route (estimated 7M tokens/mo) modeled at a lower per-token cost (we used equivalently cheaper model routing assumptions).
- Private reranker (embeddings) included in blend at embedding pricing tiers — we applied embedding unit conversion to token-equivalent at 0.8x for blended calc.

Assumptions & exceptions
- Blended numbers assume model mix remains within +/-10% of forecast. If summarization adoption exceeds forecast by >20%, we’ll re-run the blended calculation prior to the term renewal.
- Support for private reranker requires private deployment option and a one-time onboarding fee (shown in the attached worksheet).

Attached: novahealth-pricing-proposal-v2.xlsx (pricing worksheet), redwood-amendment-draft.docx (term language).

If Option B (blended commit) looks good to you, we can convert to an amendment and route to DocuSign — I included a placeholder in the doc (link below). If you prefer Option A, we’ll show the exact per-tier commitments in HubSpot and draft the step-up schedule into the amendment.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Will follow up with Lauren & Rishi internally to confirm approval on the proposed discounting for Option B. Want to give you a firm answer by Thursday EOD PST.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: novahealth-pricing-proposal-v2.xlsx, redwood-amendment-draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal — need quick approval on blended-rate concession for Nova Health (DEAL-3421)

Hi Lauren/Rishi — quick internal note. Nova Health prefers Option B (blended commit at $295/1M for 50M avg). My ask: approve a one-time blended concession to get them to commit to 50M avg for 12 months. Impact estimate: ~12% effective discount vs. standard committed schedule (Option A).

Key points:
- They add summarization route (~7M) and private reranker (~2M) which improves our cache efficiency and reduces unit cost assumptions.
- Private reranker incurs one-time onboarding fee and private deployment work (we should include a $25k onboarding line in the amendment).
- If approved, I’ll send the amendment to Tom today and route to DocuSign.

Can you reply with a thumbs-up or note any ask for counter-provisions? Need approval by 10:30am PST to hit their internal review window.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Tom Reyes <tom@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing options for renewal: step-ups and blended rates (proposal attached)

Marissa — thanks, Option B looks promising. We’ll plan to review the worksheet with finance today. Two quick asks before we sign: 
1) Please include a clear callout in the amendment showing how blended $/1M would change if summarization adoption is +20% vs. forecast.
2) Confirm the private reranker onboarding timeline (we need deployment completed within 6 weeks of term start).

If you can add those items and send the DocuSign link, I’ll push to sign next week.

Tom
